cohort: The study included 900 single-term pregnant women at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: More maternal and neonatal complications were found in the GDM group compared to the non-GDM group.
cross-section timing: GDM diagnosis was performed at the first antenatal visit, irrespective of gestational age.
gest_age: Term (for babies); GDM diagnosis was performed irrespective of gestational age at the first visit.
